description: Look closely at one item by id: a line (s013, w000042), a picture (m00123), a recording (r026), one minute of a recording (r026.0431), a theme (t-snow) or a person (p-name). Returns its words, what answers it, and links to the picture or frame.

id.description: The id, as `listen` and `search` return it: s013, w000042, m00123, r026, r026.0431, t-snow or p-name.
